meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex 在成功完成编辑类操作后会自动检查注释。若发现被标记的注释,Codex 会收到阻塞性警告,必须先修复或解释它,然后才能继续。若检查器程序缺失,则没有额外提示。
howto.when: 在 Codex 成功完成一次编辑类操作后,若注释检查器发出警告,Codex 会停下处理该注释。非编辑操作不会触发。

say.text: 修复注释检查器标记的注释。
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释再继续。

say.text: 解释一下刚才为什么会被标记。
say.note: Codex 会作出解释后再继续。

say.text: 改这段代码时,确保注释能通过检查。
say.note: 编辑成功后会自动运行注释检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Codex checks comments after successful edits. If a warning is emitted, Codex is blocked and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing. If the checker binary is missing, nothing is emitted.
howto.when_en: Triggered after a successful edit operation, when the checker emits a warning about a comment. Non-edit operations are ignored.

say_en.text: Fix the comments flagged by the checker.
say_en.note: Codex will stop and address them.

say_en.text: Explain why those comments were flagged.
Edit this code so the comments pass the check.
say_en.note: The check runs after the edit.
